project.title: Pesqueiro.GG · Hack Brasil 2026
project.description: Backlog and board for the Hack Brasil 2026 build of Pesqueiro.GG: a gamified social network for recreational anglers.

milestones.title: M0 · Foundations
milestones.description: Pipeline from branch to Dev and production, with checks and alerts.

milestones.title: M1 · Accounts, groups and the catch log
M2 · Gamification core
milestones.description: Ledger, album, levels, season ranking, reward screen.

milestones.title: M4 · Beta launch with real groups
M5 · Should-haves and polish
milestones.description: J6, J7 and what the beta asks for.

milestones.title: M6 · Demo, video and docs
milestones.description: Jurors can understand, see and try it without help.

labels.name: type: task
labels.description: Technical or team work without a user story

labels.name: should
labels.description: Should have, after the Musts of its milestone

labels.name: could
labels.description: Could have, only with spare time

labels.name: privacy
labels.description: Touches location, personal data or what leaves the server

items.title: Repo foundations and compliance
items.summary: Create the public repo with everything jurors and agents read first.
acceptance: Repo is public, created after 4 Nov 21:00, no imported history
MIT LICENSE, README skeleton and HACKATHON_COMPLIANCE.md in the first commit
AGENTS.md is the rulebook; CLAUDE.md imports it with @AGENTS.md
docs/ holds product, architecture, gamification, data model, design system, observability and delivery

items.title: App skeleton with module boundaries
items.summary: Next.js app in strict TypeScript with the ten modules and a lint rule that enforces their boundaries.
acceptance: Next.js, React and TypeScript pinned to current stable versions
src/modules/<module>/index.ts for all ten modules
Importing another module's internals fails lint
Vitest and Playwright run locally

items.title: Databases, migrations and the app database account
items.summary: Supabase projects per environment, Drizzle migrations, and a database account that can't edit the XP ledger.
acceptance: Production and demo projects in the team organization; dev project in Kauê's account; local Supabase via CLI
Drizzle schema and first migration applied by a script
App connects through the transaction pooler with prepared statements off
App account bypasses row security; row security on every table with no rules
A test proves the app account can't update or delete xp_events

items.title: Delivery pipeline: feature → dev → main
items.summary: CI, previews, environments and branch protection.
acceptance: GitHub Actions runs lint, types, boundaries, Vitest and Playwright against a local Supabase
dev and main are protected: pull request plus green CI
Merging into dev migrates the dev database and deploys the Dev environment
Merging into main migrates and deploys demo and production
Pull request previews use the dev database

items.title: Observability base and Discord alerts
items.summary: Errors, traces, logs, health checks and alert routing from day one.
acceptance: Sentry on server and browser; personal data off; catch request bodies scrubbed; no session replay
/api/health checks the database and returns the deployed commit
Uptime monitor on demo and production every 5 minutes
A test error reaches #alerts-dev; a stopped health check reaches #alerts
Webhook URLs live only in environment variables

items.title: Design tokens and app shell
items.summary: The design system's tokens, fonts and the phone shell with the bottom bar.
acceptance: Tokens from the design system drive Tailwind; no literal colors in components
Big Shoulders Display and Atkinson Hyperlegible loaded with next/font
Bottom bar with Feed, Álbum, Registrar, Desafios, Perfil
Light and dark themes follow the device and can be switched

items.title: Portuguese and English from the first screen
items.summary: i18n set up so no string is ever hard-coded.
acceptance: Messages in messages/pt-BR.json and messages/en.json
Language from the profile, else the browser
Numbers and dates follow the language; season dates use Brasília time
A CI check fails on keys missing from either file

items.title: Species catalog: research and review
items.summary: 60–100 Brazilian species with names in both languages, rarity tier and protection status, each checked by a person.
acceptance: Each species has scientific name, name_pt, name_en, habitat, rarity tier and protected flag
Rarity follows the rubric: range, difficulty, stocking
Protected status checked against Brazil's official threatened species list
Sources recorded; AI drafts are reviewed by a person
At least 40 reviewed species by 12 Nov

items.title: Sign in with Google
items.story: As an angler invited by a friend, I want to sign in with Google, so that I can join without waiting for an email.
acceptance: Google sign-in works on a phone browser
First sign-in leads to profile setup, then back to the invite
Session persists across visits

items.title: Sign up with email and password
items.story: As an angler without a Google account, I want to sign up with my email, so that I can still join.
acceptance: Confirmation and password-reset emails are sent through Resend
Signing up with an existing email leads to password recovery
Errors say what to do, in the person's language

items.title: Set up my profile
items.story: As a new angler, I want to set my nickname, photo, home city, language and title form, so that my friends recognize me and my career title fits me.
acceptance: Handle is unique and lowercase
Home city is picked from the IBGE municipality list
Title form: masculine or feminine
Language choice switches the interface immediately

items.title: Create a group and invite friends
items.story: As a group captain, I want to create a group and get an invite link, so that I can bring my fishing friends in from WhatsApp.
acceptance: Creator becomes the group's admin
Invite link and code can be copied and shared
The admin can regenerate the code, which invalidates the old link

items.title: Join a group from an invite link
items.story: As a friend who got a link on WhatsApp, I want to open it and land in the group, so that I can see my friends' catches right away.
acceptance: The landing shows the group's name and who invited me
Link to joined group in under 60 seconds with Google
Opening a link while already a member goes straight to the group

items.title: Leave a group or remove a member
items.story: As a member, I want to leave a group, and as an admin, I want to remove a member, so that groups stay among people who fish together.
acceptance: Leaving removes the group's feed and ranking from my view
Admins remove members but not other admins
A removed member's catches stop counting in that group's ranking

items.title: Upload catch photos safely
items.story: As an angler, I want my photos uploaded fast and without hidden location data, so that sharing a catch never reveals my spot.
acceptance: The browser resizes to at most 2048 px before upload
The server checks the real file type and rejects anything else
Stored as WebP at 1600, 800 and 320 px under random paths
A test proves GPS metadata is gone from stored files
A perceptual hash is saved with each photo

items.title: Get a species suggestion from my photo
items.story: As an angler, I want the app to suggest the species from my photo, so that logging is quick even when I'm unsure of the name.
acceptance: Claude Haiku 5.5 answers only with species from the catalog
Shows the top suggestion with confidence and up to 3 alternatives
The result is stored per photo on the server
Daily limit per person and a monthly cap for the app
If the AI fails, I pick the species by hand

items.title: Log a catch
items.story: As an angler back from a trip, I want to log a catch with its details and choose who sees it, so that it becomes a lasting record shared with the right people.
acceptance: Fields: species (or unknown), weight and/or length, type of water, released or kept, date, place, story
Place is a pay-to-fish lake or the city nearest to my GPS; exact coordinates stored for me only
Audience: my groups (default) and optionally public
Submitting twice with the same request ID creates one catch
Date can't be in the future

items.title: Edit or delete my catch
items.story: As an angler who made a mistake, I want to edit or delete a catch, so that my record and my XP stay right.
acceptance: Each edit raises the catch's revision and replays XP
Deleting soft-deletes the catch and reverses its XP
Only the owner can edit or delete

items.title: See my group's feed
items.story: As a group member, I want a feed of my group's catches and posts, so that I keep up with my friends between trips.
acceptance: Goes through TimelineSource (IDs + opaque cursor) and hydratePosts
20 items per page; new posts never shift the page being read
Cards show the city, never coordinates
Feed query time is logged

items.title: Open a catch page
items.story: As a friend, I want to open a catch and see its photos and story, so that I can appreciate it properly.
acceptance: Shows all photos, species with rarity badge, facts, place and story
A catch you can't see returns 404
The owner sees the exact spot on a map; nobody else does

items.title: Earn XP for fishing
items.story: As an angler, I want to earn XP for the fishing I log, so that my progress reflects variety and effort, not volume.
acceptance: Rules: catch logged (diminishing per day), new species by tier, new type of water, milestones
Pay-to-fish lakes cap the rarity bonus at Incomum; protected species kept give no XP
Saves lock the angler's row; ledger unique on (award key, revision)
Species edited back and forth leaves correct totals
Social actions never touch the ledger

items.title: Fill my species album
items.story: As an angler, I want an album where each new species fills a sticker, so that I have a reason to try new species and places.
acceptance: Paper album page with numbered slots for every catalog species
Filled stickers show my best photo or the silhouette, with the tier
Raro and Épico stickers have the sheen; Épico has the gold edge
Empty slots show the number and name
A new sticker has the Nova flag the first time I see it

items.title: Level up through the career
items.story: As an angler, I want to climb from Jovem Aprendiz to CEO dos Mares, so that my progress has a name my friends can laugh about.
acceptance: Level n needs 50 × n × (n − 1) lifetime XP
Titles in the form chosen in my profile (masculine or feminine) and in English
Crossing a level shows the promotion banner once
Progress to the next level shows on the fishing line

items.title: See my group's season ranking
items.story: As a group member, I want a season ranking for my group, so that the friendly rivalry has a scoreboard.
acceptance: Quarterly seasons in Brasília time
Counts only XP from catches the group can see
Podium for 1–3, my row highlighted, movement since my last visit
Explains in one line why scores can differ between groups

items.title: See my rewards after logging a catch
items.story: As an angler who just logged a catch, I want to see what I earned, so that logging feels like a moment, not a form.
acceptance: Shows new sticker, XP gained and ranking change from the logCatch response
Skippable with a tap; under 1.5 s
Reduced motion shows the end state only

items.title: Get notified about progress and rivals
items.story: As an angler, I want to know when I earn a sticker or level, or when someone passes me, so that I come back between trips.
acceptance: In-app bell with unread count
Sticker and level notices are written in the save; overtaken runs right after the response
Stored as type plus data, shown in the reader's language

items.title: Earn milestone badges
items.story: As an angler, I want badges for firsts and milestones, so that small achievements get recognized too.
acceptance: First catch; 5, 10, 25, 50 species; all four types of water
Shown on my profile with the date earned

items.title: React "Fisgou" to a catch
items.story: As a friend, I want to react to a catch with one tap, so that I can cheer someone on quickly.
acceptance: One reaction per person, toggled, with the fishing-hook icon
Updates instantly and rolls back if the server refuses
Only where I can see the post; gives no XP

items.title: Comment on a post
items.story: As a friend, I want to comment on a catch or post, so that we can talk about it in the app.
acceptance: Flat comment list, text only, links made clickable
The owner gets a notification
Authors delete their own comments; admins can hide

items.title: Share a tip
items.story: As an experienced angler, I want to share a tip about gear, bait, technique or a recipe, so that what I know reaches others.
acceptance: Category with fixed colors; optional species and place
Same audience options as catches
Gives no XP

items.title: Share a trip story
items.story: As an angler, I want to post a story with photos about a trip, so that the experience is recorded even without a catch.
acceptance: Text plus up to 4 photos, same pipeline as catches
Same audience options; gives no XP

items.title: Browse the public feed
items.story: As an angler, I want to see public catches from other anglers, so that I discover fishing beyond my group.
acceptance: Public posts, newest first, through TimelineSource
Hidden posts never appear

items.title: View a public profile and album
items.story: As a curious angler, I want to see someone's level, album and public catches, so that I know who they are as an angler.
acceptance: Shows only what the viewer is allowed to see
Album shows filled and empty stickers
No home city if the person hid it

items.title: Create a group challenge
items.story: As a group admin, I want to create a challenge from a template, so that our group has a goal for the month.
acceptance: Templates: most species, heaviest, longest, species goal, most released
Filters: species, types of water, released only, dates
Every member is in automatically

items.title: Compete on a challenge leaderboard
items.story: As a member, I want a live leaderboard and a final result, so that the challenge feels fair and finished.
acceptance: Leaderboard updates as qualifying catches arrive; ties go to who logged first
Catches count up to 48 h after the end; the daily job finalizes, with a heartbeat
XP only with 3+ people scoring; at most 600 challenge XP per angler per season
Finalizing twice awards once

items.title: Report a post, comment or profile
items.story: As a member, I want to report something abusive, so that the community stays a good place.
acceptance: One report per person per item, with a reason
Three reports from accounts 3+ days old with a catch hide the item until review

items.title: Review reports
items.story: As a platform admin, I want a queue of reported content, so that I can restore or remove it quickly.
acceptance: List of open reports with the content and reasons
Restore or remove; every action written to moderation_actions
Group admins can remove posts from their own group

items.title: Get notified about social activity
items.story: As an angler, I want to know when someone reacts, comments, follows me or joins my group, so that I can respond.
acceptance: Reactions, comments, new followers and members joining
Bell checks on navigation and every 60 seconds while open

items.title: Accept the terms and privacy notice
items.story: As a new user, I want to know what's collected and agree to it, so that I trust the app with my data.
acceptance: Terms of Use and privacy notice in pt-BR and en
Consent recorded at sign-up with the version accepted

items.title: Delete my account
items.story: As a user, I want to delete my account and data, so that I stay in control of what I shared.
acceptance: Removes profile, catches, posts, comments, media and XP rows
XP rows go by a database cascade; a test covers it
Asks for confirmation inside the app

items.title: Rate limits and AI spending cap
items.summary: Protect the app and the budget before real users arrive.
acceptance: Limits on catches, posts, comments, uploads, species ID and reports
Monthly AI cap turns species ID off at the limit; alert at 80%
Spending limit set in the Anthropic console

items.title: Monitoring targets and alerts
items.summary: The five targets from the system design, alerting to Discord.
acceptance: Uptime, catch-save success, feed p95, daily job and AI spending alerts configured
Each alert tested once

items.title: Impact page with totals
items.story: As the team, we want totals of what anglers create, so that the pitch shows real impact without personal data.
acceptance: Catches, species documented, stories and tips, active groups, shared links opened
Totals only; admins only

items.title: First-run experience and empty states
items.story: As someone opening the app for the first time, I want to understand what to do, so that I log my first catch.
acceptance: Empty feed, album and ranking explain the next step
Sea moment on empty states
First catch is reachable in one tap from anywhere

items.title: Beta release and invite outside groups
items.summary: Release dev → main and bring in the 2–3 outside groups.
acceptance: Release PR passes the full Playwright suite
At least one outside group has joined and logged catches
Daily triage of Sentry and feedback

items.title: Share a catch to WhatsApp with a preview
items.story: As an angler proud of a catch, I want to share a link that looks good in WhatsApp, so that friends outside the app see it and join.
acceptance: Public catch page works without login
Preview image with photo, species and sticker
Page invites the visitor to join

items.title: Enter an official public challenge
items.story: As a competitive angler, I want to enter the platform's monthly challenge, so that I can compete beyond my group.
acceptance: Join with a tap; only photo + AI matched catches count
The same photo on two accounts is flagged by the perceptual hash
Three valid reports freeze an entry until review
November and December challenges respect piracema (pay-to-fish, sea or released only)

items.title: Follow anglers and see a following feed
items.story: As an angler, I want to follow people I don't know personally, so that I see their public catches.
acceptance: One-way follow, no requests
Following feed through TimelineSource
Follow notification

items.title: Install the app on my phone
items.story: As a regular user, I want to add the app to my home screen, so that it opens like any other app.
acceptance: Web app manifest with the bobber icon
Installable on Android and iPhone

items.title: Reward animation and sea moments
items.story: As an angler, I want the reward moment to feel alive, so that each catch is worth celebrating.
acceptance: Sticker drops onto the album, sheen on Raro and Épico, XP counts up
Animated sea only on reward, album, onboarding and empty states
Reduced motion respected

items.title: Accessibility, performance and copy pass
items.summary: Meet the non-functional targets before the demo.
acceptance: Automated accessibility check passes on key screens
Main screen under ~2.5 s on a mid-range Android phone on 4G
English copy reviewed by someone reading it fresh
Dark theme checked on every screen

items.title: Demo environment seed and reset
items.summary: A believable, clearly labeled demo that can be reset before recording.
acceptance: Invented people, two groups, a season in progress, an active challenge
Photos are the team's own or openly licensed, credited in the compliance file
scripts/reset-demo.ts restores the demo in one command
Full Playwright suite passes against the demo

items.title: Record the demo video
items.summary: Three minutes in English, story first, from the demo environment.
acceptance: Follows the script on the roadmap
Under 3:00 and public without login

items.title: Final README, docs and compliance
items.summary: Everything a juror needs, in the repo.
acceptance: README: what it is, demo link, demo login, video, how to run
HACKATHON_COMPLIANCE.md lists dependencies, licenses, services and asset sources
Someone outside the team follows the README to the demo

items.title: Freeze, release and submit
acceptance: Feature freeze on 29 Nov; final dev → main
Repo public, demo and video open without our logins, monitors green
Submitted by noon on 30 Nov

items.title: Vote for the Fish of the Month
items.story: As a group member, I want to nominate one fish a month and vote on others, so that great catches get recognized without XP.
acceptance: One nomination and one vote per person per month; no voting for your own

items.title: Get push notifications
items.story: As an angler, I want notifications on my phone, so that I don't miss a reaction or a challenge result.
acceptance: Opt-in web push; works on installed app

items.title: Explore fishing by state
items.story: As a curious angler, I want to browse public catches by state, so that I discover fishing in other regions.
acceptance: State filter on the public feed

items.title: Pages for pay-to-fish lakes
items.story: As an angler, I want a page per pay-to-fish lake with what was caught there, so that I can choose where to go.
acceptance: Lake page with recent public catches and species

items.title: Protected species notice
items.story: As an angler logging a protected species, I want a short notice about it, so that I learn without being lectured.
acceptance: Neutral notice when a protected species is logged as kept
